text:
sara: Heads up: I'm scheduling a phased least-privilege sweep next week. Scope: org-level admins, project owners, and any principals with KMS admin/grant roles. Dry-run first, then staged revokes. Please review safety checks.

owen: What's the inactivity rule? Also need to flag principals with cross-project KMS grants and long-lived service account keys.

sara: Inactivity = no console/API auth + no KMS usage in last 120 days. We'll combine logs from auth, scheduler, and KMS. Dry-run will only tag `prune_candidate` not remove.

diego: Ensure snapshots and retention: IAM snapshots + KMS policy exports to encrypted bucket for 180 days. Add an immutable audit artifact for every change.

mira: Add these prechecks:
- crossproj_kms detection
- svcacct_key_last_used
- vendor_linked_ips
- recent_owner_ack (owner responded in last 90d)

audit-bot: dry-scan complete: 63 candidates, crossproj_kms=9, svcacct_active_keys=5, vendor_links=2. report: https://internal/reports/leastpriv/1811110000 :warning:

owen: For the 5 svcacct_active_keys, mark `hold_key_rotate` and notify infra-team. For the 9 cross-project grants, require owner attestation and vendor confirmation if external.

sara: Canary plan: pick 6 low-risk principals in non-prod projects. Revoke in parallel windows of 2, monitor 4h each. Recovery flow: pre-created `prune-emergency` role for ops, documented restore via saved snapshots, target RTO 15m.

diego: Also add automated smoke tests that exercise KMS decrypt and storage read for the affected resources pre- and post-change. Link smoke script in runbook.

mira: PagerDuty: bind `least-priv-sweep` and add a playbook card with steps to re-grant from snapshot. Also add an alert: auth_failure_rate > 0.1% sustained 15m.

sara: Final note: we will not revoke any principal listed in `critical-system-owners` (DB migrations, backup, infra-ops) until manual review. Posting dry-run CSV here tomorrow.

owen: sounds good. I'll review the 9 cross-project grants and raise tickets for any vendor-owned principals.

diego: I'll prep the snapshots and push the CI job that archives them.

mira: I'll add PagerDuty routing and the runbook snippet.

sara: Thanks team. If anyone needs to be excluded, reply with the principal and reason.
